mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_pairing (id, tenant_id, owner_id, owner_version, code_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{pairing.id}, #{pairing.tenantId}, #{pairing.ownerId}, #{pairing.ownerVersion}, #{pairing.codeHash}, CAST(#{expiresAt} AS timestamptz))
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_pairing SET consumed = true WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND consumed = false
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_id, owner_version, code_hash FROM c2k_pairing WHERE code_hash = #{hash} AND consumed = false AND expires_at > clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_pairing SET consumed = true WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_device (id, tenant_id, owner_id, owner_version, name, os, arch, version, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{device.id}, #{device.tenantId}, #{device.ownerId}, #{device.ownerVersion}, #{device.name}, #{device.os}, #{device.arch}, #{device.version}, #{device.tokenHash}, CAST(#{expiresAt} AS timestamptz))
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id, d.owner_id, d.owner_version, d.name, d.os, d.arch, d.version, d.token_hash, d.revoked FROM c2k_device d WHERE d.token_hash = #{hash} AND d.revoked = false AND d.expires_at > clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE OF d
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_device SET last_seen = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked = false
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.os, d.arch, d.version, CASE WHEN d.revoked OR d.expires_at <= current_timestamp OR NOT a.enabled OR a.auth_version != d.owner_version THEN 'REVOKED' WHEN d.last_seen > current_timestamp - interval '30 seconds' THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END AS status, COALESCE(to_char(d.last_seen AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'), '') AS last_seen FROM c2k_device d JOIN c2k_account a ON a.id = d.owner_id AND a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY d.name, d.id
SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_id, owner_version, name, os, arch, version, token_hash, revoked FROM c2k_device WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_device SET revoked = true WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked = false
